HORIZON-CL3-2024-CS-01 — Resilient digital infrastructure

Programme: Horizon Europe
Call: HORIZON-CL3-2024-CS-01
Topic: 952672
Topic title: Resilient digital infrastructure for critical sectors

Destination: Cluster 3 — Civil Security for Society

Expected Outcomes:
- Reduced mean-time-to-recover for critical-sector outages by 30%.
- New open standards for resilient communication protocols.
- Trained workforce across 5+ EU member states.

Scope:
Proposals should address the resilience of digital infrastructure
supporting essential services (energy, water, transport, finance),
including detection, response, and recovery.

Methodology guidance:
Validate the approach on at least two real-world pilots with
operators in different member states.

Type of action: RIA
